description: Write a professional summary (profile) for the top of one of the user's CVs, focused on experience or skills. PRO and AI consent; daily limit (429 quota_exceeded). Use when the CV has no summary or a weak one; returns {summary, usage} — save it into personal.summary with save_takemeup_cv.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: generate_takemeup_cv_summary
title: Generate professional summary (PRO)
